Felipe Massa drove for Ferrari in the 2013 races listed in the documents, and so did Fernando Alonso. Alonso appears as a Ferrari driver at the Spanish, Hungarian, Italian and Brazilian Grands Prix alongside Massa. The documents are only top-10 excerpts from a few rounds, so they don't cover every race of the season. The answer rests on Alonso being Massa's Ferrari teammate across those rounds, which is consistent with the sources but not fully confirmed for the whole year.

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
